content.text: Section 18 meets every preferred element; no conflicting or narrowing language exists elsewhere. No redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 satisfies the preferred position in full: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5M (granted unconditionally, so it necessarily covers Vendor's processing of Customer Data), workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates of insurance on request under 18.2. Coverage runs through the term plus one year, and 18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, so there is no offsetting give-back. Nothing elsewhere in the document narrows these limits or the data scope. No redline required.
